proposed.text: Under the BP 344 2024 IRR, what percentage of total guest rooms in a private hotel must be accessible?

options.text: 1% of total guest rooms, as mandated by the original BP 344 accessibility provisions
2% of total guest rooms, as a flat percentage under the 2024 IRR revision
5% of total guest rooms, reflecting the strengthened 2024 IRR requirements
10% of total guest rooms, consistent with the government-owned facility standard

proposed.rationale: The 2024 IRR mandates 2% of total guest rooms for private hotels. BP 344 2024 IRR Section 17 sets a flat rate of 2% of total guest rooms for private lodging establishments. The old IRR used a tiered formula (1 per 50 up to 150 rooms, then +1 per 100 above), but the 2024 revision replaced this with the simpler 2% flat rate. The 10% figure applies exclusively to government-owned lodging facilities.
proposed.explanation: The 2024 IRR replaced the old tiered formula with a simple 2% flat rate for private hotels.
